text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $62k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it at +2.3%, suggesting some capital is rotating into alts despite the extreme fear reading. The Fear & Greed index at 21 reflects panic conditions, but the 8-point weekly improvement and solid $70B volume indicate this dip may be finding support rather than accelerating lower. Bitcoin's 55.6% dominance is elevated, typical of risk-off periods, though Ethereum's relative strength hints that conviction holders aren't entirely capitulating.
